app.Response.description: The Response struct is used for wrapping the API response with a code, message, and data.

code.description:
Code is the HTTP status code or a custom code used to indicate the result of the request
@example 200

data.description:
Data is the response data (can be any object or null)
@example {"id": 1, "name": "John Doe"}

msg.description:
Msg is the message that describes the result of the request
@example "Request successful"

description.example: A 3-minute walk from Pier 41 in the Fisherman's Wharf district...

rating.description:
Rating is the aggregate Google rating (1.0–5.0), or null when the place has no
aggregate rating on Google (Google never assigns a 0.x average, so 0 always meant
"unrated"). A pointer so unrated serializes as `rating: null`, not a misleading 0.

url.description:
URL is Google's image URL exactly as served, including its size suffix
(e.g. `=w203-h100-k-no`). Swap that suffix to request other dimensions.

width.description:
Width and Height are the pixel dimensions of the URL as served, when
Google reports them. 0 means not captured.

author_id.description: AuthorID is the reviewer's stable Google contributor id.

author_name.description: AuthorName is the reviewer's display name.

author_photo.description: AuthorPhoto is the reviewer's avatar URL.

author_review_count.description:
AuthorReviewCount is how many reviews this contributor has written in
total, as reported by Google. 0 means not captured, and is normal for a
review syndicated from another site.

author_url.description: AuthorURL is the reviewer's public Google Maps contributor page.

id.description: ID is Google's opaque review identifier, stable across fetches.

photos.description: Photos are the images attached to this review, largest variant first.

published_at.description:
PublishedAt is the review timestamp in RFC3339 (UTC). Empty when Google
did not report one.

rating.description: Rating is the star rating this reviewer gave, 1-5.

relative_time.description:
RelativeTime is Google's own human-readable age for the review, in the
requested language (e.g. "6 months ago").

source.description:
Source is the site the review came from. Google's place pages syndicate
reviews from partner sites (notably for hotels), so this is "Google" for a
native Google review and the partner's name (e.g. "Tripadvisor",
"TrustYou") otherwise.

text.description: Text is the review body. Empty for a photo-only review, which Google allows.
text.example: I never knew pork could taste this good.

info.description: Crawlora is a hosted web-data and SERP API: call documented REST endpoints and get normalized JSON instead of HTML to parse — across search/SERP, maps and local, e-commerce, app stores, social, media and finance. One API key; Crawlora runs the proxy rotation, headless browsers and parsing behind the scenes. Billed pay-on-success: charged only on a successful 2xx response, 1-10 credits per call, with a free tier of 2,000 credits per month and no card. A hosted MCP server (mcp.crawlora.net/mcp) exposes the same catalog as agent tools. Search endpoints accept `q` as a universal alias for whichever search-term parameter they document (`query`, `term`, `keyword`, or Amazon's `k`), so one parameter name works across the whole catalog; an explicitly supplied documented name always wins.

get.description:
Returns the photos Google publishes for a specified place_id — the imagery shown on
the place's Google Maps page, typically dozens of images for a well-covered business.
Each entry carries the image URL as served plus its pixel dimensions when reported;
swap the trailing size suffix on the URL (e.g. `=w203-h100-k-no`) to request other
dimensions. Contributor avatars and review-attached photos are excluded. This is the
place page's image set, not a paginated archive feed. Rate limit is enforced at 1
request per second.

parameters.description: Maximum number of photos to return. Omit or 0 for all captured.
parameters.name: limit

X-RateLimit-Per-Second-Remaining.description: Number of remaining requests per second

get.description:
Returns the reviews Google shows on a specified place_id's Google Maps page —
typically the 8 most relevant, each with its rating, text, reviewer, timestamp, and
any photos the reviewer attached. Photo-only reviews return an empty `text`.
This is the place page's first page of reviews, not the full review archive.
Rate limit is enforced at 1 request per second.

parameters.description: Maximum number of reviews to return. Omit or 0 for all captured.
parameters.name: limit

X-RateLimit-Per-Second-Remaining.description: Number of remaining requests per second

get.description: Returns current Google News search results using anonymous HTTP requests with fresh proxy profiles, without browser rendering. Pages slice the finite result snapshot; they do not traverse the Google Search index. Results include title, source, publisher article URL, age, and thumbnail when available. Valid no-results searches and exhausted pages return an empty array. Locale defaults to country=us and lang=en. Returns 503 for blocked or malformed upstream responses.

parameters.description: 1-based page within the current finite result snapshot; defaults to 1
parameters.name: page

parameters.description: Results per page; defaults to 10, clamped to 1..50
parameters.name: count

parameters.description: Two-letter country code; defaults to us
parameters.name: country

parameters.description: Google UI language; defaults to en
parameters.name: lang

post.description: Restored JSON compatibility endpoint. Returns current Google News articles using anonymous HTTP requests with fresh proxy profiles, without browser rendering. Pages slice the finite current result snapshot. Uses the legacy result array and field names; no-results searches and exhausted pages return an empty result array.

parameters.description: Search options; keyword, language and country are required. limit defaults to 10 and is clamped to 10..100; page defaults to 1.
parameters.name: searchOption

get.description: Returns Google autosuggest query completions from the public unauthenticated suggest JSON endpoint. `source` selects the web, YouTube, or shopping suggestion list, and `rich=true` adds a type, relevance score, and short description to each suggestion.

parameters.description: Suggestions to return; defaults to 10, clamped to 1..12
parameters.name: count

parameters.description: Google result country; defaults to us
parameters.name: country

parameters.description: Google UI language; defaults to en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.description: Add Google's type, relevance score, and description to each suggestion; defaults to false
parameters.name: rich
